topic: Chat retention per space and kind, and running connectors
detail: SP-060 summary lists retention per space and kind; it has no acceptance item and is not implemented. Proposed new feature: settings for how long each space keeps chat content per container kind (DM, group DM, channel, meeting), enforced by a prune of chat sources older than that. Nothing runs a connector yet either: SP-061 or SP-062 should add the orchd unit that runs connectors on a schedule with feeds.AllowlistFrom(settings.Feeds.Chat), and the per-tenant profile directory the connector process logs in with (the gh profile pattern; orch never reads it).
